temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose notices Patricia seems more withdrawn than usual at work. When he asks if she is okay, she says it is personal stuff, downplays it, and thanks him for asking. She appreciates his offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia is usually vibrant and composed, with no known reason for concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Patricia's withdrawal and vague mention of personal stuff lead him to suspect something is troubling her, but she is not ready to share details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jose believes Patricia may be dealing with private personal issues and that she values his willingness to listen.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be available as a listener and support Patricia if she chooses to open up, without pushing her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worrying about bills and financial commitments. When he offers financial planning help, she confirms she has been overwhelmed by bills and is open to discussing budgeting.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia may be dealing with unspecified personal issues and appreciates his supportive presence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - he learns that her personal stress includes financial pressure, and that she may be willing to accept practical help from him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jose believes Patricia is financially overwhelmed and open to discussing budgeting or financial planning with him.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Deepened concern, empathy, and a desire to be helpful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Patricia with budgeting or financial planning when she feels ready.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose checks whether Patricia minded his financial planning offer. She reassures him that he was not prying and says she is grateful for his help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia is financially stressed and open to help, but he worries he may have overstepped his boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Patricia's reassurance resolves his worry; he learns his offer was welcome rather than intrusive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jose believes Patricia appreciates his support and trusts him as a friend, while he should still respect her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worry turning into relief and reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue supporting Patricia while being careful to respect her privacy.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia keeps the conversation light, says she is planning a quiet weekend, thanks Jose for his offer, and says she will keep it in mind. Jose senses she appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia welcomes his support, does not think he overstepped, and may still be dealing with personal or financial stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - he senses that although she values his concern, she wants to handle her issues privately and is not inviting deeper discussion right now.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jose believes Patricia appreciates his support but prefers privacy and independence; he should remain available without pressing her.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful concern, with slight uncertainty and acceptance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain friendly check-ins and offer support without intruding.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia tells Jose she is busy but handling things, thanks him for checking in, and says it is great to have his support. Jose reaffirms he is there to help, even for something small like coffee.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia appreciates his support but prefers to handle her issues privately, and she may still be under stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Mostly confirms prior belief - Patricia says she is managing and appreciates his support, but she does not request immediate help or disclose new problems.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jose believes Patricia values his ongoing low-pressure support and is currently handling things herself.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Warm, supportive, and reassured, with lingering concern.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To keep checking in regularly, remain available for help, and maintain a supportive presence without pushing.
